native_mechanisms: Pour each mark into the impure ('sickened') cup one at a time, letting the cup's changed colour become the seed for the next mark, so the whole pile passes as one unbroken chained pour, each mark used once.
Carry the cup's final colour through seven successive organ-bendings, each invertible and each discarding half of what it received (keeping only the bits that refuse to sit still).
Flip one mark anywhere in the pile, repeat the whole pour, and discard the entire method if the new token resembles the old one (strict avalanche acceptance test).
core_technique: Byte/word-at-a-time chained CRC-32C (table-driven software path, _mm_crc32_u64 hardware path) over a two-word rolling state where the previous CRC output seeds the next and the older state word is XORed into the input, finished by a 7-step xorshift-multiply (fmix-style) avalanche finalizer.
